title: feat(search): show match count in search panel
body:
## Summary
- show current and total match count in the custom search panel
- keep the count in sync with query, selection, and document updates
- add coverage for match count states and the close button glyph

## Tests
- pnpm.cmd vitest run packages/plugin-search/test/plugin-search.test.ts
- pnpm.cmd --filter @floatboat/nexus-plugin-search build
